data.other_hard: financial need; enrolment in a one-year taught master's programme from listed PBS master's programmes; residence in or citizenship of South Asia, Africa, or Latin America
data.evidence_sentence: Reside in or be citizens of South Asia, Africa, or Latin America.
data.notes: Deadline 'April 25' has no year, so recorded as annual. The page refers to the '/25 academic year' and may be outdated. The summary says 'Eligible Countries: Developing Countries', but the requirements list specific regions, so the regional list was used. Residence is also accepted as an alternative to citizenship, which is a residence condition rather than nationality. Applicants must show how their study will contribute to societal impact in their home region; this is an expectation, not a stated requirement. No minimum GPA is stated.
